author: GameTrailers
description:
Ambrosia Sky: Act Two is out now on PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. Watch the Ambrosia Sky: Act Two launch trailer for this concluding chapter to the clean-'em-up sim. Ambrosia Sky follows Dalia, a young field scientist in space who returns to her home colony following a world-altering crisis. Armed with an upgradeable chemical sprayer, she cleanses contaminated space stations, lays the dead to rest, and searches for answers behind the catastrophe threatening humanity.

Act Two follows Dalia’s search for her ex-girlfriend, Maeve, while continuing to recover DNA that could unlock the secret to human immortality. The story brings the central mysteries introduced in Act One to a conclusion. Act Two features new locations, additional exo-fungus species, a revamped progression system, new equipment upgrades, and new player abilities.
title: Ambrosia Sky: Act Two - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Quake: Dawn of the Machine is available now as a free update. Watch the Quake: Dawn of the Machine launch trailer to see what to expect with this new episode for the FPS. Quake: Dawn of the Machine features 19 new maps and new enemy and weapon variants.

To celebrate Quake’s 30th anniversary, the award-winning team at MachineGames—in collaboration with id Software—returns with Dawn of the Machine, a brutal new episode building on their critically acclaimed work on Dimension of the Machine and Dimension of the Past. 

End the nightmare. Escape the Illusion. 

Ranger is trapped in a dimension of endless illusion, reliving the same violent cycles for what feels like lifetimes, dying thousands of times in a futile attempt to escape. Wearied but unbroken, he has heard rumor of The Nightmare Machine.   

Beyond the hordes of monsters, twisted by an eternity in the Elder realms, lies the Machine. It is believed its destruction will shatter the illusion, finally breaking the loop.

#QuakeDawn
title: Quake: Dawn of the Machine - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 trailer to see co-op gameplay from this upcoming cooperative third-person survival shooter sequel set within the Alien universe. Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 will be available on Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Epic Games Store, and Steam on August 25, 2026. Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 will also be coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in fall 2026.

Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 drops up to four players into the boots of Colonial Marines deployed to the most hostile corners of the Alien universe. This is not a rescue mission – it’s a fight for survival. Xenomorphs stalk the corridors, ambush from the shadows, and swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last. Coordinate with your fireteam, leverage each class’s unique abilities, and adapt on the fly as encounters escalate from tense standoffs to all-out war.

#AliensFireteamElite2 #Gaming #IGN
title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 - Official Co-Op Showcase Trailer

Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears is the sequel to Rainbow Billy: The Curse of the Leviathan, expanding its colorful universe with a heartfelt adventure about the fears that often accompany growing up. The Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears prologue introduces you to the beginning of Billy's next adventure.

As Billy prepares to leave for summer camp, mysterious events at home threaten to delay his departure. While searching for a way to reach Camp Meteor, Billy must explore his surroundings, solve clever puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets, all while confronting the worries that come with change: the fear of the unknown, the anxiety of fitting in, and the possibility of being rejected before a new chapter of life has even begun.
